title: Why Do Countries Mandate Accrual Accounting for Tax Purposes?

scopes.description: Produce the full online appendix analyses, including alternative estimators, the Norway-inclusive sample, and the country-by-country sensitivity figures. The supplied appendix reports these outputs but does not specify their executable workflow or complete input lineage.

requirements.description: Author-provided analysis data and any upstream inputs needed to reproduce all appendix tables and figures are required; the supplied appendix describes a 26-country sample, a 27-country Norway-inclusive variant, alternative estimators, and country-exclusion analyses, but gives no compatible file list, schema, coverage specification, or build workflow.

issues.description: The assigned package contains only an online appendix document: no author program, entry point, run instructions, or producer map is supplied. The required input products and full workflow dependency closure therefore remain unknown.

evidence.description: The appendix reports supplementary analyses and identifies their sample and analysis variants.
evidence.quote: This Online Appendix extends the analysis carried out in “Why Do Countries Mandate Accrual Accounting for Tax Purposes?” in three ways. First, we use different estimation strategies to better account for unobservable heterogeneity between the sample countries. Second, the paper focused on the sample of 26 countries and, similar to prior studies, excluded Norway, treating it as an outlier. We, thus, replicate our main results after including data from Norway in this Online Appendix. Third, we examine the sensitivity of our results to individual country effects by excluding one country at a time.

evidence.description: Bounded package inventory lists only the appendix PDF, and the static code-coverage report has status no_supported_code.

actions.description: Request the author materials needed to regenerate the complete supplied online appendix; do not reconstruct the historical country panel or other source data independently.
steps: Obtain the author-provided executable workflow or an explicitly approved alternative, including its entry point, required run order, and runtime/software requirements for all reported appendix tables and figures.

Obtain the compatible author-prepared analysis data, or a complete input inventory and documented acquisition/build instructions that identify required files, fields, identifiers, periods, formats, and generated intermediates.
Confirm that the workflow covers the alternative-estimator analyses, the Norway-inclusive tables, and all country-exclusion figures described in the appendix.
validation: After the materials are supplied, trace every appendix output to its documented producer and verify that all required input files, fields, and sample periods are covered.
Run and compare all reported appendix tables and figures only under a separately authorized execution step.

review_notes: No analysis_only scope is supported because the assigned package supplies neither runnable analysis code nor author-prepared analysis data.
